propositions: Production bugs (3435, 3a33, 4dd2, 4c6c) resulted from store write paths that bypassed canonical write seams by using raw git commands instead of sanctioned APIs.

A deterministic two-layer CI lint (Python AST + workflow/shell parsing) must flag raw git mutations with verbs add/commit/rm/mv/reset/update-ref/checkout/clean and enforce sanction via mandatory inline marker `# raw-git-ok: <reason>`.

The legitimate store write surface consists exactly of two seams: (1) store transaction and event append internals in gitutil, event_append, txn, purge_bridge, and (2) reconciler git_adapter and _ref_lock; all other raw git writes are bypasses or disposable sandbox repos.
Intra-function tracking resolves argv through local list literals, list variables assigned literals with splat/plain pass, and opaque argv (fail-closed); marker-without-reason fails lint.
Workflow/shell layer flags git mutations only when the same step/script establishes tracker context (cd into .tickets-tracker, git -C tracker-path, or working-directory: naming tracker).

All bootstrap report-mode hits must be remediated or marked with reasoned inline markers before enforcement is enabled; lint header documents accepted residual (cross-function/dynamic argv construction).
